notes.title: Aeon of Sands - Linux version is live!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/78dcc8d1003a40318777b19c6a964460a0c09307.png

We are happy to announce the release of the Linux version of "Aeon of Sands".

SteamOS + Linux
Steam supported Ubuntu 12.04 LTS/SteamOS and we could successfully test the game on it.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/602f30ab375f59fe32082f16748f8c6e7a9dfae5.jpg

other distributions:
Furthermore, we and some users have successfully tested the game on other Linux distributions as well. These include Linux Manjaro (Arch) 64bit, Fedora Workstation 64bit and Linux Mint 64bit. However, this info is unofficial and we cannot provide any support here.

Steam Play/Proton
If the game does not run on your Linux, you can also use Steam Play or Proton to run the Windows version of the game on your Linux. Since this release also the Windows version should be compatible with Proton!

Window & macOS
The Windows and MacOS versions of the game will also be updated to v1.081.

Have fun playing and please spread the word about the Linux version!

Thank you for your support!

TwoBitsKid^Marco & Florian

notes.title: Aeon of Sands - Huge Update (Version 1.0.8)
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.8

1. Bosses improved with new abilities!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/c0038c5d74abd5e1be7e3c9bf5210bf038002f62.jpg

2. Charges now shown on Icon!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/6606c9b5df00eba0fff7d750dad4d79a785683c7.png

3. Improved range weapons and projectiles!
[code]
'smallstone' 8 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.1 + trait mod
'bolt' 14 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.4 + trait mod
'flechette' 12 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.3 + trait mod
'pellet' 20 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.2 + trait mod
'stone' 3 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.1 + trait mod
'splinteredstone' 6 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.2 + trait mod
[/code]

4. The game's difficulty can now be changed on the fly during play!

5. Improved hard mode! Combat dance and hit&run is now much more difficult.

6. Traits have levels now (just like in DM). They are shown in the character stats panel!
[code]
'Novice' 0-15%
'Beginner' 16-25%
'Competent' 26-45%
'Proficient' 46-65
'Expert' 66-85%
'Master' 86-100%
[/code]

7. Improved normal enemies. Resistances & Abilities added.
[code]
Skeletons - invulnerable auran & elemental magic damage
CyberAnts - invulnerable auran damage
Rogue Thug - invulnerable auran damage
+Enemies that cast hide spell are now also permeable (no physical damage!)
and a lot more..!
[/code]

... and much more!

New Features:

 60   - visible 'charges' on Inventory Item Icons
 1212 - change difficulty on the fly
 1190 - PauseMode added to Beginner Mode (press Space to activate)
 1433 - Ant Queen fight reworked & improved
 1431 - improve hard mode (better AI, faster turning, better usage of Magic, and a lot more improvements!)
 1427 - improve Bosses independant from difficulty modes (new abilities)
 1456 - trait levels names added to stats panel
 1465 - disable tutorial button added to every Tutorial Screen
 1357 - rising of a traits is now better written in textbox (blue)
 1459 - textbox comment added for spike damage, to better protect the feets
 1440 - improve range weapons (cooldown reduced; and stun effect added to projectiles to make range combat more fun!)


Corrections:

1421 - Route on Worldmap from Valley to Fallen Dome disabled
 1416 - Dialogue fix: COMOR OF THE LOST AND FOUNDS 2
 1422 - Dialogue fix: Valley 1 - Link1.1b
 1423 - Dialogue fix: A desert camp
 1425 - Dialogue fix: A RUIN_Screen
 1467 - A Pit Dialogue wrong image adjusted
 1419 - GATE SCENE D: when choosing Harro in marketplace, unneeded bronce helmet removed
 1411 - "sluggish" fade in / out of LargeMap fixed
 1441 - blocker in maze 6_4 removed
 1442 - correct damagetypes for green_spit, god_spit, green_spit_pool, acid_spit, reddust defined
 1430 - Flamethrower shouldn't stack; damageoutput lowered a bit; fixed
 1446 - Fix that break attack was not recognised by rangeattacks and static_enemies where affected by LOVE & UNMOVEABLE spell effects
 1439 - Combat difficulty: improved normal enemies by using Flags to add resistances
 1454 - ammo for crossbow/sling in random market added

notes.title: Aeon of Sands - Patchnotes Version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.6

Our X-mas patch is ready!

Corrections:

 a bug in the stash was fixed, where under certain circumstances an item can disappear
 two reversed results in the Skirmish were corrected
 Xunis progression in focus has been slightly improved
 non working platform in "#4n/e*#a - %5e9 Un#6rr00ts" removed
 'abs' (absorbtion) is renamed to 'prot' (protection)
 'weaponhand' and 'shieldhand' renamed to 'righthand' and 'lefthand'

 hotfixed the rewards at "A Skirmish"

notes.title: Aeon of Sands - Patchnotes Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.3

New Features:

 double-click (or middle-click) on an item in the inventory to identify items
(for touchpad/macOS users)
 hard mode is now even harder: enemy AI improved and chances to break an attack lowered
 the order of items in your inventory is now saved!
 you can now throw items into holes


Corrections:

 fixed a bug where difficulty mode was not saved into savegame and was reset to normal mode (only for new game)
 added a fix to close the hole to the ant queen, when ant queen was already killed (only for new game)
 small visual update of "a ruin" maze
 some item locations in starting mazes and "the valley" changed
 skeletons now drop 'poultice' instead of 'water skin' or 'raw meat'
 'water skin' lowered to 5 hp and 5 stamina instead of 5 hp and 10 stamina
 stats of shoes improved
 typos fixed in "the pit", "the marketplace", "xuni", "intro", tutorials and help pages
 parser fix in "skirmish" where a party of three can meet the leech
 "Centipede" made a bit faster
 "Pantellan Cutthroat" drop chance and items changed

notes.title: Aeon of Sands - preRelease Patchnotes Version 0.9.986
notes.notes:
Version 0.9.986

This is a prerelease update.

New Features:
- a visual hint has been added if a dialogue needs to be scrolled down
- consumable goods receive a green glow to make them easier to identify
- you can now configure up to three keys to fire up spells
  (still you need to open up the spellchoice first)
- added help menu categories
- note added to tooltips how to read item descriptions
- more dramatic world map presentation in a special situation
- improved the gameplay statistics screen after a complete play through
- some bosses where made a bit stronger
- nice side-effect added to 'tiny-rat' equipment item

Changes:
- fixed a problem with continuous playback of music
- fixed global music volume level for dialogue music
- fixes a bug that caused a crash when writing notes,
  if the input was not confirmed with the "enter" button
- fixed a bug that made items temp. unuseable when
  moving weapons in party-inventory from one character to the other
- spelling fixes of various dialogues
- costs of 'wooden sword' and 'rusty sword' fixed
- costs of 'flechette pistol' fixed
- tunnel updated for better handling
- readme updated
